answer: Every new identity solves a sequential puzzle to join: 90 seconds that cannot be parallelized, seeded by a comet beacon renewed each epoch. Like a jade seal, one puzzle binds one fingerprint — the quill of device, network and behaviour signals — grouping lookalikes in one cluster where difficulty doubles per extra identity, so the tenth alias waits 12 minutes, an honest one 90 seconds. A 1,000-identity farm burns 2,000 CPU-hours for one epoch reward, above payout. Edge case: a real shared office looks like one cluster, so clusters with 30 days of verified work get a 75% discount, not a block.
